notes: Printer Bot 3.2.0-beta.2 is a prerelease, a test version of 3.2.0 that can have mistakes; it reaches you only with Try prerelease versions on. It adds a paper size for the Windows printer driver: a card of 4 x 6 inches, printed in landscape. A High Roller message prints with its words in a narrow column at the left and its pictures in the rest of the card; every other receipt prints as the 80 mm receipt, made as large as the card allows. A test print on a sticker shows its TEST mark again. Everything else is as in 3.2.0-beta.1. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. A Printer Bot older than 2.5.0 needs one first (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, press Reload dock; Streamer.bot needs no restart. The full list of changes is in the release notes of 3.2.0-beta.2 on GitHub.
